verdict_line: Cognizant signed a strategic automation partnership here in December 2025. A competitor is already inside, under a CEO appointed in January 2025 and PE owners who expect a digital value-creation story. The question is displacement or coexistence.

thesis.text: A direct competitor is embedded. Cognizant announced a strategic partnership with Merchants Fleet on 3 December 2025, described as leveraging automation to modernise fleet management. Any approach must start from that fact.

The leadership question is still open. Brendan Keegan retired 17 May 2024 after fifteen years, with CFO Kirk Hoffman and SVP Brad Burgess named interim co-CEOs. A permanent successor could not be confirmed from a primary source in this pass. Establish who actually holds the chair before any senior approach.

Scale and ownership are confirmed. Over $2 billion in assets under management and 175,000 managed commercial fleet units across North America, the fourth largest fleet management company on the continent. Owned since 2022 by Bain Capital, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, and the management team.

There is an SEC-registered financing vehicle. Merchants Fleet Funding LLC files Form ABS-15G annually, signed by CFO Kirk Hoffman — a securitisation programme that generates its own data and reporting obligations.

exhibits.title: Scale, ownership and the competitive position
exhibits.headline: $2B of assets under management and 175,000 fleet units — with Cognizant already holding an automation partnership.
exhibits.body_html:
Founded in 1962 as Merchants Motors in Manchester, New Hampshire, now headquartered in Hooksett. Over $2 billion in assets under management and 175,000 managed commercial fleet units across North America, describing itself as the fourth largest and fastest growing fleet management company on the continent, with a business model focused on fleet technology, innovative fleet services and proactive electric-vehicle adoption.

Ownership was acquired in 2022 by Bain Capital together with a wholly owned subsidiary of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and the Merchants leadership team, the company continues to operate independently. CFO Kirk Hoffman, who signs the securitisation filings. The current chief executive is not established from a primary source.

On 3 December 2025, Cognizant announced a strategic partnership with Merchants Fleet to modernise fleet management through automation.
exhibits.sowhat: Private-equity ownership plus a new CEO plus EV transition planning is exactly the profile that buys AI and data services — but Cognizant got there first. The realistic play is adjacent scope: EV duty-cycle and charging-siting modelling, or the securitisation data estate, rather than a head-on displacement.
